comment: 16-core cache sweep, 3 archs x 4 layers x 5 samples, L1 pinned at 8 KB. L1 leaves the axis list by user ruling, so the swept cache axes are line size (cin_block 1/2/4 -> 16/32/64 B at cout_block 16, weight_bytes 1), shared L2 size, and prefetch distance: 3 x 3 x 4 = 36 configurations. A sweep cannot mix line sizes (one mapper per wcache_sweep), so each trace is 3 units of 12 configs. Units = 3 archs x 4 layers x 5 samples x 3 line sizes = 180; rows = 180 x 12 = 2160. 8 KB is the plan's nominal because it sits exactly on the quarter-storage line at every core count. Schedules come from outputs/schedules/inst16, solved against configs/arch/<arch>_inst16.yaml, which is the 128-node baseline with instances 16 and no NodeLevel local_buffer cap -- the multinode_sweep inst16 configs impose one and spinalflow's two deep layers are infeasible under it.
